svg.desc: The 40-degree observation at 3 minutes is included by the at-or-below rule. One observation at 5 minutes is missing; the line is interrupted there. Five of eight known readings satisfy the rule. This is a recorded-time decision, not an exact continuous crossing time.
svg.title: Classifying a synthetic temperature record
